entries.back_en: I am a Valkyrie. We are the key of the fallen, we serve to perpetuate their existence beyond this world. You must accompany me.

Get out of here? Listen to me carefully, mortals. We are gifted with the knowledge of life and death. I can see in the palm of my hand how the line that binds you to this world was extinguished when you became imprisoned.
Mere presence eliminates all possibility of doubt. You must accompany me. Your destiny lies here no longer.
In that case, I will leave, you will never see me again and those who decide to stay will fade into dust with the passage of time.
Alright. Listen to me, everyone! No one expected it to end like this, but we've run out of options. I'm going in gradually!
entries.note: Typo 'Ouvçam'; 'Vou entrando' shifts meaning from decisive 'I'm going in'.

entries.back_en: Riva... I will not be able to keep my promise. May the Gods protect Zarga...
Oh, brave warrior who fell in the heat of battle!
